title: GOV.UK brand.yml
text:
An unofficial _brand.yml that themes Bootstrap, bslib and Quarto sites with GOV.UK Design System colours. This page is themed by that same file - what you’re looking at is the demo.
Here’s a link to the repo - tab to it, or to any button below, to see GOV.UK’s black-and-yellow focus state.

title: GOV.UK brand.yml
text:
Code
A short shinyGovstyle example, to show how code blocks and inline code (like button_Input()) are styled:
ui <- shiny::fluidPage(
  shinyGovstyle::header(
    org_name = "Example",
    service_name = "User Examples",
    logo = "shinyGovstyle/images/moj_logo.png"
  ),
  shinyGovstyle::gov_layout(
    size = "two-thirds",
    shinyGovstyle::button_Input(
      inputId = "btn1",
      label = "Continue",
      type = "default"
    )
  ),
  shinyGovstyle::footer(full = TRUE)
)

title: GOV.UK brand.yml
text:
Buttons
Bootstrap buttons styled after GOV.UK’s: square corners, a darker bottom shadow, a darker hover and a pressed state. Success matches GOV.UK’s default button, danger its warning button, secondary its secondary button, and info its inverse button. Warning uses palette orange, as GOV.UK keeps yellow for focus only.
